description: ENS / Basename resolve. Resolve an ENS name (vitalik.eth) or Basename (jesse.base.eth) to an address, or an address to its verified primary ENS name. On-chain, deterministic, no LLM. Example output: {"input":"vitalik.eth","name":"vitalik.eth","address":"0xd8dA6BF26964aF9D7eEd9e03E53415D37aA96045","registry":"ethereum"}. Price: $0.0045 USDC on Base via x402 (pass the payment in _meta["x402/payment"]).
name: name_resolve
